name: OneDrive
description: OneDrive is Microsoft’s cloud storage solution enabling users to store, sync, and share files across devices, offering offline access, real-time collaboration, and enterprise-grade security

tools.name: Add Workbook Worksheet
tools.description: Adds a new worksheet to an existing Excel workbook in OneDrive or SharePoint. The worksheet is created with the specified name and appended to the end of the workbook's worksheet collection. Use this action when you need to create a new sheet in an Excel file to organize data, add reports, or separate information into logical sections.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Optional name for the new worksheet. If omitted, Excel determines the worksheet name. If a worksheet with this name already exists, the API will return an error.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workbook item (Excel file) where the worksheet will be added. Must be a valid driveItem ID for an Excel workbook. Obtain from ONE_DRIVE_LIST_FOLDER_CHILDREN, ONE_DRIVE_SEARCH_ITEMS, or similar operations.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the workbook. Obtain from ONE_DRIVE_LIST_DRIVES or similar operations.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID. Use this to add the worksheet in an existing Excel workbook session.

tools.name: Calculate Workbook
tools.description: Recalculate formulas in an Excel workbook at the requested depth.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: DriveItem ID of the Office Open XML workbook to recalculate.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive containing the workbook. Use 'me' for the connected user's drive, or provide a Microsoft Graph drive ID.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID to recalculate inside an existing Excel workbook session, so session-local edits are included.

inputs.name: calculation_type
inputs.about: Calculation depth: Recalculate recalculates dirty cells, Full recalculates all formulas, and FullRebuild also rebuilds dependencies.

tools.name: Check In Drive Item
tools.description: Tool to check in a checked out driveItem resource, making the version of the document available to others. Use when you need to check in a file that was previously checked out in OneDrive or SharePoint.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.about: A check-in comment that is associated with the version.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the item to check in.

inputs.name: check_in_as
inputs.about: Optional. The status of the document after the check-in operation is complete. Can be 'published' or unspecified.

inputs.name: drive_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the driveItem to check in.

tools.name: Checkout Drive Item
tools.description: Tool to check out a driveItem to prevent others from editing it and make your changes invisible until checked in. Use when you need to lock a file for exclusive editing in SharePoint or OneDrive.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the item to checkout.

inputs.name: drive_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the driveItem (file or folder) to checkout.

tools.name: Clear Workbook Range
tools.description: Clears values, formats, or both from a worksheet range in an Excel workbook stored in OneDrive or SharePoint without deleting cells or shifting neighboring data. Use this action when you need to reset a range while preserving the worksheet's cell structure.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The range address in A1 notation to clear without deleting cells or shifting surrounding data.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The DriveItem ID of the Excel workbook whose worksheet range should be cleared.

inputs.name: apply_to
inputs.about: The part of a workbook range to clear.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the workbook. Use 'me' for the authenticated user's default OneDrive, or provide a OneDrive/SharePoint drive ID.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID to send in the workbook-session-id header.

inputs.name: worksheet_id_or_name
inputs.about: The ID or name of the worksheet that contains the range to clear. Names with spaces or special characters are URL-encoded automatically.

tools.name: Close Workbook Session
tools.description: Close an Excel workbook session without deleting the workbook.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: DriveItem ID of the workbook whose session is being closed.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive containing the workbook. Use 'me' for the connected user's drive, or provide a Microsoft Graph drive ID.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Workbook session ID returned by ONE_DRIVE_CREATE_WORKBOOK_SESSION.

tools.name: Copy Item
tools.description: Copies a DriveItem file or folder, optionally renaming it or specifying a destination folder. Copy requests may be asynchronous; a monitor URL is returned when supplied by the service, and an accepted request does not mean the copy is complete.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the copied item. If not provided, the same name as the original is used. Recommended to provide either 'name' or 'parent_reference' for reliable operation.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the DriveItem to be copied.

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.about: The ID of the site if the item is in a SharePoint site.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The ID of the user if accessing another user's drive.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The ID of the drive where the item is located. If not provided, 'me' (user's default drive) is assumed.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The ID of the group if the item is in a group drive.

inputs.name: children_only
inputs.about: If set to true, only the children of the source driveItem (if it's a folder) are copied, not the driveItem itself. Defaults to false. Cannot be used with name parameter.

inputs.name: parent_reference
inputs.about: Reference to the parent item (folder) where the copy will be created. If not provided, the item is copied to the same location. Recommended to provide either 'name' or 'parent_reference' for reliable operation. Must use stable OneDrive item IDs (not paths or names), as paths break on rename/relocati

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: Specifies how to handle a naming conflict if an item with the same name already exists in the destination. 'fail' (default), 'replace', or 'rename'.

inputs.name: include_all_version_history
inputs.about: If set to true, the version history of the source file is copied to the destination. Defaults to false.

tools.name: Create Drive Item Permission
tools.description: Tool to create a new permission on a OneDrive drive item. Use when you need to grant application or SharePoint group permissions to a file or folder. This endpoint supports creating application permissions and SharePoint site group permissions only.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: Array of Microsoft Graph role strings to assign to the permission. Documented/common values include read, write, and owner for SharePoint/OneDrive for Business permission resources; tenant/resource-specific roles may also be accepted by Graph.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive.

inputs.name: drive_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive item.

inputs.name: granted_to_v2
inputs.about: The identity to grant permission to. Must contain either application or siteGroup property.

tools.name: Create Sharing Link
tools.description: Tool to create a sharing link for a DriveItem (file or folder) by its unique ID. Use when you need to generate a shareable link for an item in OneDrive or SharePoint.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of sharing link to create. Valid values: `view`, `edit`, `embed`.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: The scope of the sharing link. `anonymous`: anyone with the link can use it; choose it only when the user explicitly asks for anonymous or 'anyone with the link' access, never by inference. `organization`: people signed in to the tenant; available only in OneDrive for Business and SharePoint. `users

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive item (file or folder) for which to create the link. Note: Some item types cannot be shared, including embedded objects, certain system files, and items with restricted permissions. If sharing fails with 'notSupported' error, verify the item type supports sharing.

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the site. Use this if the item is in a SharePoint site's drive.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the user. Use this if the item is in another user's drive.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive. If not provided, the link will be created in the current user's drive (me/drive).

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the group. Use this if the item is in a group's drive.

inputs.name: password
inputs.about: The password for the sharing link. Optional and OneDrive Personal only.

inputs.name: recipients
inputs.about: The people to share with when scope is 'users'. Required when scope is 'users'; if provided while scope is omitted, scope defaults to 'users'; not allowed with scope 'anonymous' or 'organization' (an empty list is treated as omitted). Each recipient is an object with one of `email`, `alias`, or `obj

inputs.name: expiration_date_time
inputs.about: The expiration date and time for the permission, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. Example: 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z Must be a future UTC timestamp; past values will cause the call to fail.

inputs.name: retain_inherited_permissions
inputs.about: If true (default), existing inherited permissions are retained. If false, all existing permissions are removed when sharing for the first time.

tools.name: Create SharePoint List Item
tools.description: Create an item in a SharePoint list using Microsoft Graph through the OneDrive connection. Use when you need to add a new row/item to a SharePoint list after resolving the site ID and list ID.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Field values for the new list item, keyed by SharePoint internal column name. For a basic custom list, include at least {'Title': 'New item'}.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the SharePoint list where the item will be created. Use ONE_DRIVE_LIST_SITE_LISTS to find list IDs.

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.about: The Microsoft Graph SharePoint site ID in composite format, usually 'hostname,site-collection-id,web-id'. Use ONE_DRIVE_GET_SITE_DETAILS or ONE_DRIVE_LIST_SITE_LISTS outputs to confirm the site ID.

tools.name: Create Upload Session
tools.description: Create only a resumable upload session for a named file; this action does not upload bytes. It returns a short-lived preauthenticated uploadUrl for an external fragment uploader. Keep the URL secret and do not send an Authorization header to it.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive ID. Omit to use the connected user's drive.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Name of the file the upload session will create.

inputs.name: file_size
inputs.about: Optional total file size in bytes. This property is supported by OneDrive Personal.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional file description. This property is supported by OneDrive Personal.

inputs.name: defer_commit
inputs.about: Whether uploading all fragments requires a separate explicit commit.

inputs.name: if_match_etag
inputs.about: Only create the session when the target resource matches this ETag.

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: Parent folder DriveItem ID. Use 'root' for the drive root.

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: Behavior when an item with the target name already exists.

inputs.name: if_none_match_etag
inputs.about: Only create the session when the target resource does not match this ETag.

tools.name: Create Upload Session By Path
tools.description: Create only a resumable upload session at a root-relative path; this action does not upload bytes. It returns a short-lived preauthenticated uploadUrl for an external fragment uploader. Keep the URL secret and do not send an Authorization header to it.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive ID. Omit to use the connected user's drive.

inputs.name: file_size
inputs.about: Optional total file size in bytes for an early quota check. This property is supported by OneDrive Personal.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional file description. This property is supported by OneDrive Personal.

inputs.name: defer_commit
inputs.about: Whether uploading all fragments requires a separate explicit commit.

inputs.name: media_source
inputs.about: Optional media-source metadata for OneDrive for Business or SharePoint.

inputs.name: if_match_etag
inputs.about: Only create the session when the target resource matches this ETag.

inputs.name: destination_path
inputs.about: Root-relative path including the destination file name. Use '/' between path segments and do not include a leading slash.

inputs.name: file_system_info
inputs.about: File system information on client.

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: Behavior when an item with the target name already exists.

inputs.name: drive_item_source
inputs.about: Optional source-application metadata for OneDrive for Business or SharePoint.

inputs.name: if_none_match_etag
inputs.about: Only create the session when the target resource does not match this ETag.

tools.name: Create Workbook Session
tools.description: Create a persistent or temporary session for an Excel workbook.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: DriveItem ID of the Office Open XML workbook.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive containing the workbook. Use 'me' for the connected user's drive, or provide a Microsoft Graph drive ID.

inputs.name: persist_changes
inputs.about: True to save workbook changes; false to create a temporary, non-persistent session copy.

tools.name: Delete Item
tools.description: Delete a DriveItem (file or folder) by ID from a specified drive or user's OneDrive, defaulting to the authenticated user's drive. The item is moved to the recycle bin rather than permanently deleted; storage quota is not freed until the recycle bin is emptied.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the DriveItem (file or folder) to be deleted.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's ID, email, or 'me'. Defaults to 'me' (authenticated user). Required for S2S (app-only) auth.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Drive where the item is located. If not provided, the action will target the user's personal OneDrive (me/drive). Always specify drive_id explicitly for group drives, SharePoint site drives, or shared libraries to avoid silently querying the wrong drive.

inputs.name: if_match
inputs.about: (Optional) If this request header is included and the eTag (or cTag) provided doesn't match the current tag on the item, a `412 Precondition Failed` response is returned, and the item won't be deleted.

tools.name: Permanently Delete Drive Item
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a driveItem by its ID without moving it to the recycle bin. Use when you need to irreversibly remove a file or folder from OneDrive or SharePoint. This action cannot be undone.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive item (file or folder) to permanently delete. This action deletes the item without moving it to the recycle bin and cannot be undone.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the item to permanently delete.

tools.name: Delete Drive Item Permission
tools.description: Tool to delete a permission from a drive item. Use when you need to revoke sharing access to a file or folder. Only non-inherited sharing permissions can be deleted.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive item (file or folder).

inputs.name: perm_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the permission to delete. Only non-inherited sharing permissions can be deleted.

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of a SharePoint site. Use this if the item is in a SharePoint site's drive.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of a user. Use this if the item is in a specific user's drive (other than 'me').

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive. If not provided, the action will target the user's personal OneDrive (me/drive).

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the group. Use this if the item is in a group's drive.

tools.name: Delete Shares Permission
tools.description: Tool to delete the permission navigation property for a shared drive item. Use when you need to remove a sharing link permission. This effectively revokes access via the specific share link.

inputs.name: shared_drive_item_id
inputs.about: The share ID or base64-encoded sharing URL. This is the shareId returned from the createLink API response. Example format: u!aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21wb3NpbzIwMjQtbXkuc2hhcmVwb2ludC5jb20vOng6L2cvcGVyc29uYWwva2FyYW52YWlkeWFfYXV0aGtpdF9haS9JUURPT2NCVEx5RTFSWktVQkJGZ0YzZVZBUmI4Zk5XVjdhMUJidGQ1NDF2SEdXUQ

tools.name: Delete SharePoint Item Permission
tools.description: Revoke a Microsoft Graph beta permission from a SharePoint list or list item.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Optional SharePoint list item ID. Provide this to revoke a list-item permission; omit it to revoke a list-level permission.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the SharePoint list.

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.about: The Microsoft Graph SharePoint site ID in composite format, usually 'hostname,site-collection-id,web-id'.

inputs.name: permission_id
inputs.about: The Microsoft Graph permission ID to revoke.

tools.name: Delete Workbook Range
tools.description: Deletes a range of cells from an Excel worksheet in OneDrive, shifting remaining cells up or left to fill the gap.

inputs.name: range
inputs.about: The address of the range to delete in A1 notation. Can be a single cell (e.g., 'A1') or a range of cells (e.g., 'A1:D4'). The range must be valid for the worksheet.

inputs.name: shift
inputs.about: The direction to shift remaining cells after deletion. 'Up' shifts cells upward to fill the gap, 'Left' shifts cells leftward.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Excel workbook item. This is the driveItem ID of the .xlsx file containing the worksheet.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the workbook. Use the drive ID from list drives or get drive operations.

inputs.name: worksheet
inputs.about: The name or ID of the worksheet containing the range to delete. Can be the worksheet name (e.g., 'Sheet1') or the worksheet ID.

tools.name: Delete Workbook Worksheet
tools.description: Deletes a worksheet from a workbook in OneDrive by its ID or name. Use this action when you need to remove a specific worksheet from an Excel workbook stored in OneDrive or SharePoint. This action is irreversible — the worksheet cannot be recovered once deleted. Note that deleting the last visible worksheet in a workbook may result in an error.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the workbook item (Excel file).

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The ID of the drive containing the workbook.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID. If provided, will be sent in the 'workbook-session-id' header to maintain session context.

inputs.name: worksheet_id_or_name
inputs.about: The ID or name of the worksheet to delete from the workbook. Can be either the worksheet's unique identifier or its display name (e.g., 'Sheet1').

tools.name: Discard Checkout
tools.description: Tool to discard the checkout of a driveItem, releasing it and discarding any changes made while checked out. Use when you need to cancel a checkout and revert changes on a file in SharePoint or OneDrive.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the item to discard checkout.

inputs.name: drive_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the driveItem (file or folder) to discard checkout.

tools.name: Download a file
tools.description: Downloads a file from a user's OneDrive using its item ID, which must refer to a file and not a folder. Response contains a content object with the downloaded file, MIME type, and name; raw file data is not returned directly. Parsing content from Excel, Word, PDF, or other formats requires additional tooling. The downloaded file can be passed to downstream tools such as OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL or OUTLOOK_CREATE_DRAFT.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Optional format for file conversion during download. 'pdf' converts supported source files (doc, docx, dot, dotx, dotm, dsn, dwg, eml, epub, fluidframework, form, htm, html, loop, loot, markdown, md, msg, note, odp, ods, odt, page, pps, ppsx, ppt, pptx, pulse, rtf, task, tif, tiff, wbtx, whiteboard,

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Raw item ID only (e.g., '1234567890ABC'). Do not include URL fragments or query parameters like '&cid=...' or '?param=...' from sharing links.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User's ID or User Principal Name (UPN), or 'me' for the authenticated user's OneDrive. Ignored when drive_id is provided.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The ID of the drive containing the file. Required for SharePoint or OneDrive for Business drives. When provided, user_id is ignored.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Desired filename (including extension) for the downloaded content.

inputs.name: if_none_match
inputs.about: Optional ETag or cTag value for conditional download. If the provided tag matches the current file's tag, the API returns HTTP 304 Not Modified without downloading the file, saving bandwidth. Useful for caching scenarios.

tools.name: Download file by path
tools.description: Downloads the contents of a file from OneDrive by its path. The API returns a 302 redirect to a pre-authenticated download URL. Use when you know the file path but not the item ID.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's ID, email, or 'me'. Defaults to 'me' (authenticated user). Required for S2S (app-only) auth.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Desired filename (including extension) for the downloaded content.

inputs.name: item_path
inputs.about: The path to the file in OneDrive, relative to the drive root (e.g., 'document.txt' or 'folder/subfolder/file.pdf'). Do not include leading slash.

tools.name: Download item as format
tools.description: Tool to download the contents of a driveItem converted to a specific format (e.g., PDF or HTML). Use when you need to convert Office documents to PDF or Loop/Fluid files to HTML before downloading. Supports accessing items by item_id or by path, and can target specific drives via drive_id.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Format to convert the item to. Use 'pdf' for Office documents (doc, docx, ppt, pptx, xls, xlsx, etc.) or 'html' for Loop/Fluid files (loop, fluid, wbtx).

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the driveItem to convert. If provided, this takes precedence over path_and_filename.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User's ID or User Principal Name (UPN), or 'me' for the authenticated user's OneDrive. Ignored when drive_id is provided.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive. Optional - use for SharePoint document libraries. If not provided, uses the default drive.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Desired filename (including extension) for the downloaded converted content.

inputs.name: path_and_filename
inputs.about: Path and filename of the driveItem under root (e.g., 'Documents/report.docx' or 'presentation.pptx'). Do not include leading slash. Either item_id or path_and_filename must be provided.

tools.name: Download Item Thumbnail
tools.description: Download thumbnail image bytes for a DriveItem identified by item ID.

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: Thumbnail size: small, medium, large, smallSquare, mediumSquare, largeSquare, or a custom size such as c300x400 or c300x400_crop.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: DriveItem ID whose thumbnail to download.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive ID containing the item. Omit to use the connected user's drive.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Optional output filename. Directory components are discarded. Defaults to a generated JPEG filename.

inputs.name: thumbnail_id
inputs.about: Zero-based thumbnail set index.

tools.name: Download Drive Item Version Content
tools.description: Tool to download the contents of a specific previous version of a drive item (file). Returns the actual file content. Note: You cannot download the current version using this endpoint - it only works for previous versions.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive item (file). Cannot be a folder ID.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the file. If not provided, defaults to the user's personal OneDrive (me/drive).

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Desired filename (including extension) for the downloaded version content.

inputs.name: version_id
inputs.about: The ID of the specific version to download (e.g., '1.0', '2.0'). Cannot be the current version - only previous versions can be downloaded using this endpoint.

tools.name: Download Thumbnail by Path
tools.description: Download thumbnail image bytes for a path-addressed item in the current user's OneDrive.

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: Thumbnail size: small, medium, large, smallSquare, mediumSquare, largeSquare, or a custom size such as c300x400 or c300x400_crop.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Optional output filename. Directory components are discarded. Defaults to a generated JPEG filename.

inputs.name: item_path
inputs.about: Drive-relative path to the item. Do not include a leading slash or the /root: prefix.

inputs.name: thumbnail_id
inputs.about: Zero-based thumbnail set index.

tools.name: Follow Drive Item
tools.description: Tool to follow a driveItem (file or folder) in OneDrive or SharePoint. Use when you need to add an item to the user's followed items list for tracking updates.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive containing the item to follow. This can be the ID of a personal OneDrive, a group's document library, or a SharePoint site's drive.

inputs.name: drive_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the driveItem (file or folder) to follow. DriveItem IDs are case-sensitive and must be used exactly as returned from Microsoft Graph API operations like list, search, or folder children queries.

tools.name: Format Workbook Range
tools.description: Apply dimensions, alignment, wrapping, font, fill, and borders to a workbook range. Components are updated sequentially, not atomically, so earlier formatting remains if a later update fails.

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: Optional fill-color change for the range.

inputs.name: font
inputs.about: Optional font changes for the range.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: Range in A1 notation, such as A1:D10. Accidental wrapping quotes are removed and embedded apostrophes are escaped for OData.

inputs.name: borders
inputs.about: Optional border changes, with at most one entry per side.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: DriveItem ID of the Office Open XML workbook.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive containing the workbook. Use 'me' for the connected user's drive, or provide a Microsoft Graph drive ID.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Workbook session ID returned by ONE_DRIVE_CREATE_WORKBOOK_SESSION.

inputs.name: base_format
inputs.about: Optional dimensions, alignment, and wrapping changes.

inputs.name: worksheet_id_or_name
inputs.about: Worksheet ID or exact worksheet name containing the range.

tools.name: Get document comments
tools.description: Extracts comments from a Word .docx file in OneDrive. The action downloads the document, parses the OOXML comments part, and returns structured comment data inline. When possible, it also includes the selected text and paragraph context from the document body so agents can understand what each comment refers to.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Raw item ID of the Word .docx file. Do not include URL fragments or query parameters like '&cid=...' or '?param=...' from sharing links.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: User's ID or User Principal Name (UPN), or 'me' for the authenticated user's OneDrive. Ignored when drive_id is provided.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The ID of the drive containing the Word document. Required for SharePoint or OneDrive for Business drives when the file is not in the authenticated user's default drive. When provided, user_id is ignored.

tools.name: Get Drive
tools.description: Retrieves properties and optionally expanded relationships of a Drive resource, including a specific drive or a user's, group's, or site's drive.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the drive. This can be the ID of the user's personal OneDrive, a group's document library, or a specific drive ID. Must be a valid, non-empty value; use ONE_DRIVE_LIST_DRIVES to obtain valid drive IDs.

inputs.name: expand_fields
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of relationships to expand and include in the response. For example, "root,list" to include the root folder and list information. This allows you to retrieve related resources in a single request.

inputs.name: select_fields
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of properties to include in the response. Use this to retrieve specific fields and reduce the response size. For example, "id,name,driveType". If not provided, all default properties are returned.

tools.name: Get DriveItem by Sharing URL
tools.description: Resolve a OneDrive or SharePoint sharing URL or share ID to drive item metadata and available IDs. An optional sharing-link redemption setting can grant durable access to the item.

inputs.name: sharing_url
inputs.about: A OneDrive or SharePoint sharing URL (e.g., 1drv.ms link, SharePoint link, or Teams contentUrl). This will be automatically encoded to a sharing token. Mutually exclusive with share_id_or_encoded_url.

inputs.name: prefer_redeem

inputs.name: version_id
